package.description: Fast, lightweight markdown and Mermaid viewer for Windows

en-US.description: Fast, lightweight markdown and Mermaid viewer for Windows
en-US.longDescription:
Tinta is a fast, lightweight markdown viewer and reader for Windows,
built with Direct2D and DirectWrite for hardware-accelerated rendering.
A single native executable of about 2.5 MB that starts in under 100 ms -
no Electron, no web engine, no installer. Features review annotations with a copy-for-agent loop, plain-text file references with mouse back and forward navigation, rendered link previews on hover, export to HTML, DOCX
and PDF plus optional Pandoc export to EPUB, ODT, PPTX, RTF and LaTeX, a Win11-style tabbed interface with drag and drop, session
restore and a tab context menu, an icon menu for file actions and settings,
full file-path copying, cross-document heading links, local PDF links, configurable frontmatter with opt-in created/updated
timestamps, footnotes with HTML/DOCX support, individual H1-H6 and highlight
colors, expanded syntax highlighting, resizable Contents through H6 and a
resizable file browser, separate inline-code theme colors, native LaTeX
math with matrices, cases, aligned equations and equation-local macros, native rendering for
twenty-two Mermaid diagram families (flowcharts with subgraphs, sequence,
class, state, ER, C4, requirement, architecture, block, sankey, packet,
kanban, treemap, radar, pie, git graphs, gantt, mindmaps, timelines,
journeys, quadrant and xy charts), custom themes with a built-in editor,
shortcut profiles, a UI in seven languages, first-class CJK text layout,
glyph-precise text selection, a table of contents and folder browser that
can be pinned open beside the document, full-text search, zoom, a start
page with recent files, and a unified editor whose rendered page floats
beside the source with live diagram preview, click-to-edit tables, and a full-width preview of unsaved edits.
en-US.name: Tinta
en-US.releaseNotes:
Tinta v4.0.2

Installation
- Easiest: winget install "Tinta Markdown Viewer" -s msstore (Store-signed, no security prompts, auto-updates), or the Microsoft Store page
- Portable: download tinta.exe below and run it (SmartScreen may ask: "More info", then "Run anyway")
- Optionally run tinta.exe /register to register Markdown, Mermaid and PlantUML files
A fix release for 4.0.1. For what is new in 4.0 (Live and Sheets), see the v4.0.0 notes.

Added
- Pinned tabs, from a tab's menu: a pinned tab keeps to the start of the row as its first letter and stays in view. The title bar's pin is remembered for the next start. Requested by @Fallgrim (#312)
- Equation numbers with \tag, and \eqref and \ref to an equation's \label, in the reader and the HTML and Word exports. Requested by @TiegenFang (#314)
- With wrapping off, a scrollbar along the source editor's foot for lines that run past it, and the horizontal wheel pans them. Requested by @TiegenFang (#314)
- mathFont= and cjkFont= in settings.ini name the faces for equations and for Chinese, Japanese and Korean letters. Requested by @TiegenFang (#314)

Changed
- Source and Live follow a file another program changes, as the reader does, and ask Reload or Keep mine when there are unsaved edits. Requested by @QuamerX (#311)
- Each level of a bullet list has its own bullet, closer to its text. In Live, Tab takes an item one level in and Shift+Tab undoes it, and only the line being typed in is highlighted. Requested by @Fallgrim (#315)

Fixed
- A double-click in Source selects whole words in every script, Turkish, Greek and Cyrillic included. Reported by @Fallgrim (#313)
- Selections over bold, italic, links and code are one even band, without seams in the reader or brighter strips in Live. Reported by @Fallgrim (#313)
- Two $$ equations in a row are set as two, and Word exports include $$ equations. Reported by @TiegenFang (#314)
- An inline $ equation can close before a letter, as in pandoc, so $R=50\,\mu$m no longer runs on; prices stay text. Reported by @TiegenFang (#314)
- Signs after brackets, brackets beside slanted letters and accents such as the tilde are set as TeX sets them. Reported by @TiegenFang (#314)

What's included
- Export as HTML, DOCX, or PDF, plus optional Pandoc formats
- 22 natively rendered Mermaid diagram families, and PlantUML diagrams through a local PlantUML
- Tabbed interface with drag, session restore, and a tab context menu
- 10 tuned themes (5 light, 5 dark) plus custom themes
- Hardware-accelerated rendering via Direct2D
- Single portable executable about 4 MB, no dependencies
